description: The REVERSE-SEARCH relational operators of the START KEY phrase - LESS, NOT GREATER, LESS OR EQUAL and their symbols (<, NOT >, <=) - ISO 14.9.41.4 GR9 b) (relative: 'searching the file in reverse order') and GR17 d) (indexed: 'the file is searched in reverse order'). COBOL-85's START searches FORWARD only - the set GR9 a) / GR17 c) still name first, which NOT LESS and NOT < fold into, so they stay legal at 85 (conformance:cases/14.9.41-START/pb370_start_forward_operators); A.3 item 39 binds the reverse set to READ ... PREVIOUS in ONE sentence as ONE reverse-access processor capability, and READ PREVIOUS is read-previous-2002. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): ANSI X3.23-1985's START (§1985:VIII.4.7.2, §1985:IX.4.7.2) lists only EQUAL TO, =, GREATER THAN, >, NOT LESS THAN, NOT <, GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO and >=, and positions forward only: §1985:VIII.4.7.4 GR4a, 'The file position indicator is set to the relative record number of the first logical record in the file whose key satisfies the comparison', and §1985:IX.4.7.4 GR4a, 'The file position indicator is set to the value of the key of reference in the first logical record whose key satisfies the comparison'; §2002:14.8.37.3 GR9b ('If the relational operator is LESS, NOT GREATER, or LESS OR EQUAL, the file position indicator is set to the relative record number of the first logical record in the file whose key satisfies the comparison searching the file in reverse order') and GR17d ('the file is searched in reverse order with the key of reference being extracted from each record') add the reverse set, and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 129: 'START FIRST, LAST, and LESS THAN. The START statement has been enhanced to allow starting to a position before the key and to point to the first or last record in the file.' §2014:14.9.37.3 GR9b carries the same sentence, so 2014 = 2023. Gated on RECOGNITION in the VersionConformancePass parse arm (VisitStartKeyPhrase, the operator folded by ConditionBinder.MapOperator, the same fold KeyedIoBinder binds), so an ill-organized or unbindable START still names the edition (kb/Work PB370).
display: a reverse-search START KEY operator (LESS, NOT GREATER, LESS OR EQUAL)
citation: §1985:VIII.4.7.2; §1985:VIII.4.7.4 GR4a; §1985:IX.4.7.4 GR4a; §2002:14.8.37.3 GR9b; §2002:14.8.37.3 GR17d; §2002:F.2 item 129; §2014:14.9.37.3 GR9b; §2023:14.9.41.4 GR9b; §2023:14.9.41.4 GR17d; §2023:A.3 item 39 (READ PREVIOUS and the reverse START operators, one processor-dependent capability)
vcr: 2002 introduction (quoted: §2002:14.8.37.3 GR9b/GR17d and §2002:F.2 item 129 against §1985:VIII.4.7.4 GR4a / §1985:IX.4.7.4 GR4a), bound to read-previous-2002 by A.3 item 39

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMSTRV.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmstrv" ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE
        ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC RELATIVE KEY IS W-K.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-K PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN INPUT F.
    START F KEY IS LESS THAN W-K INVALID KEY DISPLAY "E".
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.
